event_chain.summary: Partner/customer licensing spreadsheet emailed to wrong recipients

summary: On January 13, 2026 an EMEA-based strategic account manager at cloud marketplace Pax8 mistakenly emailed fewer than 40 UK-based partners a CSV file of internal business information covering about 1,800 MSP partners, mostly in the UK. The spreadsheet had more than 56,000 rows listing partner and customer names and IDs, Microsoft SKUs and license counts, bookings, renewal dates and account owners. The sender tried to recall the message and asked recipients to delete it.
